あらすじ

We finally started going out.

I had finally achieved happiness, but a simple slip-up leads to that man blackmailing me.

There’s no going back…

The shameful punishment enacted on my body at school during “class time” starts to escalate.

I have no choice but to take the lessons to protect my boyfriend…
